relations: The partially melted popsicle rests on its red pool, so continued warming spreads the liquid outward across the plate.
The wooden stick stays attached to the green rind end while the red body softens and loses shape.
The dark seed dots remain fixed on the glossy surface as the surrounding flesh thins into the pool.
The white plate holds the spreading liquid, so the puddle widens without the popsicle lifting off.
